idea-plugin.name: AI Usage Trackers
idea-plugin.description:
Track local AI token usage in the IntelliJ IDEA status bar with persistent history and configurable trackers. Start with Today and This week, or choose calendar periods, rolling durations and supported provider reset-aligned weeks.

  • Read Codex logs, with experimental Claude assistant-log and Antigravity capture support.
  • Keep accounts separate and switch between enabled vendors or rotate them in a carousel.
  • Customize colors, fonts and the scrolling ribbon with a settings preview.
  • Show the last request and quota percentages and reset times where available.
  • Review usage details and warnings, and import or export tracker settings.

Reads local files without model calls or telemetry. Coverage depends on the source; Claude and Antigravity support is experimental: synthetic tests pass, but validation by contributors with subscriptions is required before verified support can be claimed. Both require source configuration.

Getting started · Report an issue · MIT License · Privacy Policy
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0: A current-day tracker can also restart at the selected weekly quota reset.

1.0.1: Recover safely when monitor changes temporarily prevent pointer detection. Automatic movement pauses and hover popups remain stable until detection recovers.

1.0.0: Track local AI usage with configurable status-bar trackers, persistent history, vendor/account selection, quota displays where available, appearance controls and configuration import/export. Claude and Antigravity support is experimental and awaits validation by contributors with subscriptions.
